semantics.structural_owner_tf: same as source_tf unless a separate merge/family rule is explicitly confirmed
semantics.display_tf: native structure is displayed on its own chart unless post-selector lifecycle marks the child TRANSITION_NO_TL; then the configured parent TF owns that display chart
plan_b_examples: H4 TRANSITION_NO_TL -> D1 geometry copied to H4
M15 native disabled -> H1 geometry copied to M15

m15_policy.reason: M15 is display-only in this audit. Its native movement is too abrupt/noisy for stable ownership; use H1 geometry without reselection.

important: TL transition state is resolved after source selection and before display mapping.
ACTIVE: current native TL is valid.
TRANSITION_NO_TL: old TL is broken and no replacement N is active.
NEW_ACTIVE: a replacement N satisfies the existing two-anchor + Decision-HL closed-bar break rule.
REFERENCE_RETAINED: rolling 600-bar selection cannot reconstruct a native candidate, but chronological pre-cutoff lifecycle replay proves the TL was already established and retained.
REFERENCE_RETAINED is not allowed to override OLD_TL_BROKEN_NO_UNBROKEN_REPLACEMENT_N.
When H4 is TRANSITION_NO_TL, D1 becomes the H4 display owner.
M15 native selection is disabled; H1 owns M15 display.
Destination charts never reselect source geometry.
No trade authority or production NCA_DRAW writeback is allowed.

h1_h4_merge_policy.reason: 09/05 transition audit uses explicit lifecycle ownership instead of nonexact H1/H4 merge.

visibility_policy.objective: Select one native family per enabled source TF, resolve TL lifecycle, then assign display ownership. Parent inheritance occurs only under an explicit transition rule.
visibility_policy.current_price_metric: Project TL/CH to the latest closed bar of the display timeframe. Distance is zero when price lies inside the channel; otherwise use distance to the nearest channel boundary.
visibility_policy.note: No fixed source-to-adjacent copy except explicit transition inheritance. H4 may inherit D1 only in TRANSITION_NO_TL; M15 always inherits H1 because native M15 is disabled.

preview_isolation.reason: User confirmed this is a drawing-only audit; all non-preview chart objects may be removed for clean visual verification.
preview_isolation.note: Objects created by indicators are chart objects and may also be removed.

H4.reason: During the gap after the old H4 TL breaks and before a replacement H4 N is activated, display the still-valid D1 structure on H4.

M15.reason: M15 does not own a native TL in this audit; display the exact H1-selected geometry.

retained_lifecycle_policy.selection_horizon_semantics: 600 bars limits new selection; it does not delete a TL established earlier in lifecycle history.
